# Brief

The project researches computer-use agents that control computers through screens, mice, and keyboards, including products, models, methods, safety, and benchmarks. It also archives focused AI-for-math research, including formalization coverage, manuscript releases, and reasoning traces.

The repository also contains a separate learning area for tracking subjects the user wants to learn, beginning with a problem-first, text-only mathematics path. The learning notes directory is a possible future target for iPad-to-homelab synchronization; synchronization itself is separate from the learning archive.
